title: Trailer my game - Inner Orbit - 4 months of ai assisted dev
author: StellarSoupStudio
selftext:
Solo Dev, built using Claude Code, started on sonnet 4.6, now using opus 5.5.



Initial seed of the game was a JS project I made back in 2018, now the game runs in a custom Rust engine and is optimized to run on minimal hardware specs (I'm targeting ARM processors with 2gb of ram)



Currently has a complete Act 1, about 30 minutes of tested gameplay.



Main hook of the game is realistic orbital physics. It's sort of a tower defense and inspired by Asteroids (obviously) as well as Missile Command and KSP.



If you want to try it out:
